paragraphs: SchoolMint sells enrollment software to K-12 schools and districts. Customers range from whole school systems down to a single campus.

The product follows the path a family takes, from digital advertising and lead nurturing through applications, student placement and registration. One module is built to handle the enrollment journey itself. Districts with heavier needs are offered tools for school choice that the company says improve access and strategic planning. Predictive enrollment analytics is listed among those advanced options.

The company traces its start to 2013. Two parents frustrated by their own district's enrollment process began it. Operations were later centralized in Lafayette, Louisiana. Remote staff also work across the United States and in Greece and Costa Rica. The leadership page names Jinal as a co-founder who started the company with Forum Desai in 2013.

quote.text: At SchoolMint, we’re here to help schools create bright, sustainable futures.
